Subject: Post-call recap + proposed demo windows

Hi Daniel / Asha — thanks again for a productive discovery earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the technical deep dive: 

Key takeaways:
- Primary goal: evaluate Redwood for secure inference on PHI workloads (SOC2 + VPC).
- Scope: embedding search + multi-turn chat for clinician workflows; SSO + audit logs are required.
- Success criteria: <10ms median token latency for 8k context, deterministic routing to private deployment, and evidence for SOC2 controls.

Next steps I propose:
1) 60-minute technical deep dive (product + infra) where Ben runs architecture walkthrough and Karthik answers procurement questions.
2) Share Mutual Action Plan and draft SOW (attached) for review.
3) Confirm attendees and preferred time windows this week or next.

Can you confirm the people who should attend from your side (dev lead, infra, security, procurement)? Below are two proposed windows in PDT (happy to pick other slots):
- Tues 11 Aug, 10:00–11:00 PDT
- Wed 12 Aug, 14:00–15:00 PDT

I attached the MADP and a first-pass SOW; also linking the HubSpot deal (for mutual reference). If procurement needs SOC2 artifacts ahead of time, we can surface the report (see link).

Thanks — once you pick a slot I will send the calendar invite and Zoom link.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
